📌 Affiliate Program — Brand Presentation Text

• About our brand and products:
🔷VOS STORE🔷 is a modern electronics brand offering reliable, high-quality devices for everyday use. Our product range includes 🔷(ex: smartphones, headphones, tablets, speakers, etc.)🔷 designed to improve comfort, productivity, and connectivity. We focus on innovation and customer satisfaction with products that combine performance and affordable pricing.

• What makes us different:

  • Excellent quality-price ratio

  • Modern designs and durable materials

  • Continuous product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Fast delivery and professional customer support

  • Exclusive offers and regular new releases

We bring premium tech to everyone — without the premium price.

• How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn 11% commission on each sale generated through their personalized referral link or discount code.
There is no limit — the more you promote, the more you earn.
Payments are made 🔷(weekly / monthly — à définir)🔷 via 🔷(ex: PayPal, bank transfer)🔷.

• How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote on any channel, such as:

  • TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube

  • WhatsApp / Messenger groups

  • Blogs, websites, and review pages

  • Word-of-mouth directly to friends & family

We provide:
✓ Marketing visuals
✓ Product details
✓ Personalized promo codes and tracking links

• Other information:
We are looking for motivated ambassadors with a passion for electronics and social engagement.
Support is always available if you need help to boost your sales.
We grow — and we want you to grow with us. 🚀
